# Real tagged captures (hardening unit U6)

Recorded 2026-11-25. Server: keyless, from `/data/be-ops-skin` branch `ops-hardening`, HEAD `97414316c` (the brief commit `4c793fa25` on the cut `0402ed2be` plus the U5 CLI commit; no server or client file differs from the cut except `games_controller.rb`, unit U4's `routeRoom`, which landed later and was not loaded). Recorder: `response-capture.js` at `63f7c75f6` (1.0.21: `pc` and `hash` tags). Games made with `swap-scenario-game.rb`, never `new-game`. Headless, `--speed fast`, `--capture-responses`.

How they were driven: C3 was driven live, beat by beat, by hand through the harness. C1 and C2 are replays: the command stream (the `in` lines of the earlier session logs `regression-test_ops_mfa/session-227` and `s5bc-playtest-3/session-226`, the earlier full playtests of the same two PLAYTEST files) was fed to a fresh game with the original pauses (capped at 75 s). Every request in the files was made by the real client. Passwords and notes are the scenarios' own; the captures hold no forged request.

**C4 (`demo_ops_second_step`) is not here.** A replay of the earlier Run B diverged (staff timing: no sign-in happened, `verify-run --access` did not match), so it was dropped, not kept. The lock push cancel (M14 to M17) was not driven. P11 and the cancel tests use server-answer rows.

Checks run (`verify-run.rb --access <game>`, matching the earlier runs' recorded access lines line for line, game id aside): C1 same as game 227, C2 same as game 226, C3 four accounts cracked, Eli infeasible. `verify-run.rb --ops-log` gives "ops log OK" for all three. `access-leak-check.rb <game> <file>` with no entries gives "no leaks found" on C1 to C3 with the CLI as it stood at `e1dde1015` (checked at review R1, 2026-11-25; the CLI at `97414316c` called `tag_problem` before it existed, so this was not true when this note was first written).
